Moore to Buffalo** (BUF sent a 2026 2nd; CHI sent Moore + a 5th), removing the offense's highest-volume incumbent target and ~$16.5M in cap. Second: this is Loveland's **first healthy offseason** — he missed most of the 2025 program after shoulder surgery from his final Michigan year and *still* led the team in receiving (58-713-6, first Bears rookie TE to lead the team in receiving yards since Ditka in 1961; 8-137 in the wild-card win). Attended Tight End University in late June. Ben Johnson at June minicamp: *"He's one of the most consistent players I've been around… We've been able to take the route tree to the next level."* Healthy, no designation; CHI camp 7/29–8/27. *Refresh 2026-08-03 — **THE 'DECISIVE CHANGE' LEG IS FALSIFIED.** The D.J. Moore trade was NOT a July development: it was agreed **~March 4–5, 2026** and official at the new league year ~3/11 ([Chicago Sun-Times 2026/03/05](https://chicago.suntimes.com/bears/2026/03/05/bears-dj-moore-trade-bills-says-goodbye-nfl-fans-teammates-halas-hall); [Bills.com official](https://www.buffalobills.com/news/buffalo-bills-officially-acquire-wide-receiver-dj-moore-from-bears-via-trade)). A thesis premised on 'the field hasn't priced this yet' cannot rest on a five-month-old transaction — the market has had a full offseason and a draft. **This inverts the 7/26 reading:** seven flat weeks of consensus (#36→#38) after a fully-digested trade is the field **pricing** him, not missing him. **→ FLAGGED DEMOTE CANDIDATE (still NOT demoted — see 8/16 fold below for why).** **·· FRESHENED 2026-08-26 (research-diff item 4) ·· FIRST REAL POSITIVE SIGNAL since the flag went up.** Bears lost to Cincinnati 27-9 in preseason Wk2 (8/22); starters (incl. Caleb Williams) played only the opening series. Williams went 2-of-5, and BOTH completions were tight-end/WR: **Loveland (1 catch, 10 yds) and Odunze (1 catch, 18 yds)** — Williams also missed Loveland on a potential TD in the red zone on that same series. **Cole Kmet did not draw a target in the sample.** Read against the row's own 8/16 falsifiable trigger ("If Loveland does not clearly out-target Kmet with the ones, DEMOTE at the next sweep"): in the one series the starters played, Loveland clearly out-targeted Kmet (1 target + a near-TD vs. zero) — the trigger fired POSITIVE, not negative. Sample is tiny (one drive, five pass attempts) — directional confirm, not season-defining — and preseason Wk3 is very likely another starters-rest week (Ben Johnson has sat starters, or played them one series, in both Wk1 and Wk2), so this may be the last real data point before the draft. **Still NOT demoted**: field still at TE3/#37 vs the claim of overall TE1, no lead time to measure yet — demoting would still be premature. HOLD Active. What survives and is current: Loveland starred in the first fan-attended practice (4 catches in the two-minute period) and **Caleb Williams said he 'can become the best tight end in the league'** ([247Sports](https://247sports.com/nfl/chicago-bears/article/ahead-of-pivotal-year-two-colston-loveland-making-big-strides-in-chicago-bears-training-camp--288601899/)).* **·· PRESEASON WK1 FOLD 2026-08-16 ··** **HOLD in Active — run A decided against the requested demote, and the reasoning is the point.** The D.J. Moore leg above is **STRUCK** (falsified 8/03 — the trade was March, not July; a March transaction the field has had five months to digest is not an edge). But demoting to *Consensus* would be **factually wrong**: Consensus means the field caught up, and the field is still at **TE3 / #38** against a claim of overall **TE1 over Bowers and McBride**. The gap between claim and price is unchanged, so there is **no lead time to measure**, and demoting would corrupt the audit ledger the Consensus section exists to protect. **New situational leg replacing the dead one:** Ben Johnson intends **13-personnel with all three TEs on the field** — Chicago ran **94 three-TE snaps in 2025, 5th in the NFL** ([Sun-Times](https://chicago.suntimes.com/bears/2026/08/04/bears-coach-ben-johnson-now-has-3-premium-talents-at-tight-end-and-his-offense-is-about-to-get-wild) **pub 2026-08-04**). Logged neutrally on purpose — see Counter. **⏱ FALSIFIABLE TRIGGER SET, which this row has lacked since 8/03: the preseason Wk2 Loveland-vs-Kmet snap split and target distribution (8/20–23). If Loveland does not clearly out-target Kmet with the ones, DEMOTE at the next sweep.** Preseason Wk1 gave zero evidence either way — **neither tight end played.**
